## Checklist

- [ ] Code passes `golangci-lint run ./...`
- [ ] All tests pass `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] New code has unit tests and/or property tests
- [ ] Exported symbols have GoDoc comments
- [ ] Configuration changes are reflected in `config.yaml` and docs
- [ ] Schema changes have been regenerated with `go generate`
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (if user-facing change)
